parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of the display, primarily made of glass with a thin protective layer. It is the main visual interface of the device.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays images, videos, and text output from the computer or other connected devices. It is the primary output component of the display.
parts.Movement_description: The screen itself is fixed and does not move independently, though the entire display may tilt or swivel via the stand.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of durable plastic. It supports the screen and provides stability on a flat surface.
parts.Functional_description: The base holds the display upright and may allow for limited tilt or rotation adjustments. It ensures the monitor remains stable during use.
parts.Movement_description: The base itself is stationary, but it may allow the screen to pivot or tilt depending on the design.
